events.label: Request accepted into bounded local queue
Reading line, tool and unit records

evidence.extraction_method: SELECT production_date, line, shift, fpy_pct, units_built, first_pass_units FROM first_pass_yield WHERE production_date = CAST('2026-11-10' AS DATE) ORDER BY line, shift

SELECT tool_id, CASE WHEN timestamp < CAST('2026-11-09 10:05:00' AS TIMESTAMP) THEN 'before return' WHEN timestamp < CAST('2026-11-11 06:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) THEN 'review window' ELSE 'after verification' END AS period, ROUND(AVG(angle_deg), 2) AS angle_deg, ROUND(AVG(actual_nm), 2) AS torque_nm, COUNT(DISTINCT unit_id) AS units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT passed THEN unit_id END) AS exception_units FROM torque_results WHERE line = 3 GROUP BY tool_id, period ORDER BY tool_id, period

SELECT u.supplier_lot, u.line, COUNT(DISTINCT u.unit_id) AS units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT t.passed THEN u.unit_id END) AS exception_units FROM units AS u JOIN torque_results AS t USING (unit_id) GROUP BY u.supplier_lot, u.line ORDER BY u.supplier_lot, u.line
read-only downtime query; separate Line 2 drive; no automatic causal attribution

observed_fact.sql: SELECT * FROM downtime WHERE line = 2 AND shift = 2 AND start_time >= CAST('2026-11-10 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND start_time < CAST('2026-11-11 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)

evidence.extraction_method: SELECT u.unit_id, u.status, u.built_at, u.shipped_at, u.supplier_lot, u.line, u.shift, MIN(t.tool_id) AS tool_id, MIN(t.timestamp) AS first_result_at, MAX(t.timestamp) AS last_result_at, ROUND(MAX(t.angle_deg), 3) AS max_angle, COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT t.passed THEN 1 END) AS outside_limit_bolts FROM units AS u JOIN torque_results AS t USING (unit_id) WHERE t.line = 3 AND t.tool_id IN ('T40-B') AND t.timestamp >= CAST('2026-11-09 10:05:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND t.timestamp < CAST('2026-11-11 06:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY u.unit_id, u.status, u.built_at, u.shipped_at, u.supplier_lot, u.line, u.shift ORDER BY u.unit_id

# WI-L3-S40 | Revision C | Released 2026-10-26
Plant 7. Body Shop and General Assembly. Line 3. Station 40.
Generic midsize SUV body. Fixture bracket fastening. Controlled copy.
1. Confirm unit ID and bracket part suffix against traveler.
2. Clamp the fixture and verify both locating pins seated.
3. Inspect fasteners and hand start all four bolts.
4. Confirm tool program P40. Nominal torque 40 Nm, limits 38 to 42 Nm.
5. Confirm tool ID, daily verification, and operator qualification.
6. Tighten in the STAR PATTERN: bolt 1, opposite bolt 3, bolt 2, opposite bolt 4. Do not substitute a clockwise sequence. Angle acceptance is 78 to 102 degrees.
7. Confirm four recorded results and release the clamp only after acceptance.
8. On abnormal angle or sequence, hold the unit and contact Quality. Do not override the result.
After calibration, verify the tool on the reference fixture before production release.

# PFMEA-L3-S40 | Revision F
Process: bracket fastening, Line 3 Station 40.
Failure mode: uneven joint preload despite acceptable final torque.
Potential causes: angle channel calibration error; incorrect bolt sequence.
Effect: bracket seating variation and downstream joint integrity concern.
Current controls: daily tool check, sequence confirmation, torque and angle trace.
Reaction plan: segregate units since last verified good reference check. Verify tool against a reference fixture; confirm star pattern with a qualified operator.
Recheck suspect shipped serials with downstream Quality; shipping status alone does not establish defect.
Engineering must approve release criteria and disposition. Do not infer actual joint preload from video alone.
